description: A React component implementing infinite scrolling with debounce, loading indicator, and end-of-data handling.

classes.name: InfiniteScroll
classes.description: A React component that provides infinite scrolling functionality, loading more items as the user scrolls near the bottom.

methods.name: validateBuffer
methods.description: Ensures the buffer value is at least the default scroll buffer.

methods.name: getAmountOfPages
methods.description: Calculates total number of pages based on total items and items per page.

methods.name: handleScroll
methods.description: Handles the scroll event, triggers callback to load more data when near bottom.
